_comment: Devnet deploy config. Copy to a path outside the repo (it names real wallets), fill every <FILL: ...>, and pass it with --config. Values without <FILL> are proposals from spec §8; the founder confirms them (spec §12 Q3).

squads.multisig: <FILL: Squads v4 multisig address (members and threshold set at its creation)>
squads.timeLockFloorSecs: <FILL: agreed time-lock floor in seconds (spec §12 Q15)>

upgradeAuthority: <FILL: the vault that holds the upgrade authority — the same vault under Q15 option (a), the upgrade multisig's vault under (b)>
operator: <FILL: operator pubkey — the KMS key from mutav-app, or a devnet test key>
mutavCapitalWallet: <FILL: MUTAV capital wallet (owns neither money account)>
treasuryAccount: <FILL: BRS token account receiving MUTAV's fee take>
paymentsAccount: <FILL: BRS token account receiving claim payments>
feeTakeBps: <FILL: take rate in bps, at most 3000 (spec §12 Q4)>

caps._comment: BRS base units (6 dp). Spec §8 proposals: R$100k reserve, R$30k per guarantee, R$60k per agency, R$10k / R$20k claim payments per call / per 30 days, TESOURO 0% in the pilot, requests R$1k–R$30k, partial-fill floor R$500.

price._comment: TESOURO is not held in the pilot (no adapter), so the price fields are placeholders. maxNavMoveBps is 10000 (100%) on devnet on purpose: the NAV-move guard measures the move gross, so a large guarantee-fee batch or claim payment against a small demo reserve would trip it and halt fulfilment. The inflow-adjusted guard is ADR 0013 (pending); until then, if the guard trips, the admin clears it with clear_fulfil_halt (ADR 0015). Lower it for the real pilot.

allowlist: <FILL: MUTAV capital wallet, plus any devnet investor wallets>
